US.description: Covers groceries, utilities, transportation, health-related expenses, and miscellaneous spending for a single individual, excluding rent.

IN.description: Cost of living for essentials like groceries, local transportation, utilities, and personal care in major Indian cities.

SG.description: High cost of living, excluding rent, primarily driven by groceries, transport, and dining expenses.

CH.description: Very high costs for groceries, transportation, and dining out.

NL.description: Food, utilities, public transport, and leisure activities are moderately high.

GB.description: Covers groceries, transport, utilities, and leisure activities; generally high across the UK.

CA.description: Covers groceries, transportation, utilities, dining, and personal care for a single individual, excluding rent.

AE.description: High cost for dining out, entertainment, and utilities (especially during summer), while groceries and transportation are moderate.

NO.description: High costs for groceries, transportation, and dining out are typical across the country.

IE.description: High cost of living, particularly for groceries, utilities, and transport. Dining out and leisure activities are also expensive.

LU.description: Overall high cost for groceries, public transport, utilities, and dining out.

AU.description: General expenses including groceries, transportation, utilities, and leisure.

QA.description: High cost of living driven by imported goods, dining, and expatriate-oriented services.

BN.description: Cost of living excluding rent is moderate, with affordable local food and very cheap fuel, though imported goods can be more expensive.

MO.description: The cost of living in Macao is high, largely due to expensive imported goods, dining out, and leisure activities. Utilities and transportation are moderately priced.
